# Holanda BJJ Academy

> Beginner-friendly Brazilian jiu-jitsu academy at 47 Franklin Street, Framingham, Massachusetts (MA 01702). Classes for adults, kids ages 4 to 13 and no-gi. No experience needed, and the first class is free.

## Where and how to contact
- Address: 47 Franklin Street, Framingham, MA 01702, United States
- Phone: (508) 361-7778
- Email: holanda.bjjacademy@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/holanda.bjjacademy/
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=47+Franklin+Street,+Framingham,+MA

## Programmes
- Beginners (adults, day one): a dedicated entry point for complete beginners. The fundamentals in a calm, structured setting; no uniform and no experience required for the first class.
- Adults Jiu-Jitsu (gi, all levels): the core programme. A curriculum that starts from the very first grip and keeps challenging experienced grapplers.
- Jiu-Jitsu Kids (ages 4 to 13): children train with children their own size, and parents are welcome to stay and watch the whole class.
- No-Gi Grappling (all levels): grappling without the kimono, in shorts and a rash guard.

## How to start
1. Fill the short form on the page (under a minute).
2. Pick date and time: choose the class you want and a day and time that work for you.
3. Get the details in writing: the address, what to wear, what to bring and what the class looks like.

The first class is free, with nothing to sign that day. For day one, a t-shirt, shorts and a bottle of water are enough; for gi classes there is a kimono to borrow. Membership depends on the programme and on how often you train, and the options are explained after the free class.

## Coach
- Professor Diego Holanda (Diego do Nascimento Holanda), head coach and the name on the door.
